title: OrbitQuant: Data-Agnostic Quantization for Image and Video Diffusion Transformers
question: 这篇论文存在哪些局限性或未来工作方向？
gold_answer: 论文的局限性包括：1）OrbitQuant继承了基于旋转的量化带来的在线旋转成本，每次前向传播都需要对激活进行RPBH旋转，虽然成本较小，但存在运行时开销；2）由于Lloyd–Max质心是非均匀的，而整数张量核心在均匀网格上计算，因此没有现成的内核支持码本GEMM，当前实现需要将码本反量化后再以BF16格式运行矩阵乘法。未来工作方向是构建一个融合内核，在GEMM前序阶段收集质心并以原生低位格式计算。

gold_evidence.text: OrbitQuant inherits the online rotation that comes with rotation-based quantization. Unlike weight-only or BF16 inference, it applies the RPBH to activations at every forward pass, so a runtime rotation cost accompanies the memory savings, though this cost is small.

Integer tensor cores compute on uniform grids, where the matmul runs directly on the quantized codes, while Lloyd–Max centroids are non-uniform, so no off-the-shelf kernel computes a codebook GEMM. Our current path therefore dequantizes codes and runs the matmul in BF16, as do all baselines under fake quantization.

Lookup-table GEMM kernels for non-uniform weight quantization [14, 34] suggest the path forward, and we will build a fused kernel that gathers centroids in the GEMM prologue and computes in a native low-bit format.

title: Will Scaling Improve Social Simulation with LLMs?
question: 这篇论文提出的核心方法是什么？
gold_answer: 该论文的核心方法是利用缩放定律（scaling laws）研究LLM的计算规模、通用能力基准与社会模拟保真度之间的关系。具体而言，作者在三个代表性子领域（意见建模、行为模拟、纵向预测）中，使用一套85个基于Qwen3架构、在DCLM语料上预训练的Transformer LLM，在固定计算预算（10^18到10^20 FLOPs）下测量计算缩放对任务损失的影响，并进一步评估35个更大的开源模型以预测下游准确性。

gold_evidence.text: We use scaling laws to study the relationship between LLMs’ compute scale, general capability benchmarks, and the fidelity of social simulation in three representative sub-domains: opinion modeling, behavioral simulation, and longitudinal forecasting.

Surprisingly, we discover strong compute scaling in all three settings, using a suite of 85 transformer LLMs with the Qwen3 architecture pre-trained on the DCLM web text corpus under fixed-compute budgets from 10^18 to 10^20 FLOPs.
Then we evaluate 35 larger and more capable open-weight models up to 70B parameters, allowing us to predict downstream accuracy from loss.

title: Will Scaling Improve Social Simulation with LLMs?
question: 作者是如何证明所提方法有效的？
gold_answer: 作者通过实验发现，在能力方面，模型与人类的相关性较弱（Pearson r 范围为0到0.85），尤其对预训练数据中代表性不足的人群。此外，扩展未能改善模型在风险厌恶等认知偏差以及从相关任务中学习相关奖励等启发式方面的校准。为了挑战这些零扩展结论，作者对0.5B到8B参数的Llama3和Qwen2.5模型进行了微调，但在这些零扩展任务上，微调后也未观察到参数扩展带来的改进。这表明，尽管总体模拟会随着模型改进而提升，但存在异常值，且在低资源领域改进的可靠性较低。

gold_evidence.text: competence (the Pearson r ranges from 0 to 0.85), with particularly weak correlations for demographic populations that are underrepresented in pre-training data. Moreover, scaling fails to improve model calibration with human cognitive biases like risk aversion, as well as human heuristics like learning correlated rewards from related tasks.

To challenge our null scaling conclusions, we fine-tune a suite of Llama3 and Qwen2.5 models from 0.5B to 8B parameters. However, on these null scaling tasks, we also fail to observe parameter scaling after fine- tuning.
This shows that, although aggregate simulation will improve with general model improvement, outliers exist, and improvements will be less reliable in low-resource domains.

title: Will Scaling Improve Social Simulation with LLMs?
question: 这篇论文报告了哪些关键实验结果？
gold_answer: 论文报告了三个关键实验结果：首先，在行为模拟（Psych-101）、纵向预测（ACL）和观点任务上，仅通过扩展计算量（FLOPs）就观察到任务损失的log-linear改进，且模型方差解释率至少为85%。其次，纵向预测任务中，通用模型能力与任务性能相关，但扩展预训练计算量无法完全解决该任务，最佳模型准确率仅为65%，预计上限为77%。第三，对于某些社会模拟任务（如认知偏差），扩展计算量未能提升性能，即使经过微调，模型性能也未随参数规模单调提升。

gold_evidence.text: We observe log-linear improvements in task loss on all three social science tasks after scaling compute alone with models trained on DCLM from 1018 to 1020 FLOPs.

The best model we evaluated observationally was Yi 1.5 34B, which achieved an accuracy of 65%, with 0.9 loss. Our composite scaling estimates suggest that improving performance by an additional 5% on this task would require loss to fall by 0.36, demanding models trained optimally on over 1000 times more compute.

For such tasks, even fine-tuned Qwen2.5 and Llama3 models fail to demonstrate performance improvements with scale, indicating that compute scaling alone is insufficient to improve performance for this small set of social simulation tasks.

I report a pilot designed to estimate (i) whether human capital moderates the value of AI assistance in forecasting, and (ii) whether distinct interaction styles mediate that moderation.

The moderator that organizes the pattern is collaborative human capital, especially perspective-taking, curiosity, and intellectual humility, consistent with broader findings that heterogeneity in collaboration ability drives the returns to hybrid intelligence (11–14).

title: Ming.Human Capital & Hybrid Intelligence.arXiv
question: 这篇论文报告了哪些关键实验结果？
gold_answer: 论文报告了三个关键实验结果：第一，混合智能表现呈三模态分布，大多数参与者要么完全依赖模型（Automators），要么用模型验证自己先前的猜测（Validators），只有少数人（Cyborgs）实现了真正的互补推理，其准确度达到甚至超过市场基准。第二，Cyborgs在智力谦逊、好奇心和观点采择等协作特质上显著优于其他混合预测者，而原始认知能力或模型基准无法区分这一模式。第三，人类资本（而非模型基准）预测了混合智能的准确性，Cyborgs的预测误差低于每个单独AI模型，且与市场基准无显著差异。

gold_evidence.text: hybrid performance is trimodal: most people either deferred to the model (matching it) or used it to rubber-stamp a prior guess (performing worse than the model alone), while a minority engaged in genuine complementary reasoning and reached accuracy matching or even exceeding (i.e., lower error than) the market itself.

Cyborgs exceeded other hybrid forecasters on intellectual humility (6.5 vs. 4.4, d = 4.1), curiosity (6.7 vs. 5.1, d = 4.0), and perspective-taking (6.5 vs. 4.6, d = 3.2), with smaller but reliable differences in fluid reasoning (d = 1.5) and g (d = 1.7) (all p < .01; Fig. 1B).

Only Cyborgs improved on the machine: 3.8 (CI 3.5–4.1, n = 9), lower error than every individual AI model and statistically indistinguishable from—indeed numerically below the mean of—the strongest models, significantly better than Automators (p < .001).

question: 这篇论文提出的核心方法是什么？

Persistence changes the monitoring dynamic; the threat lies in the sequence of PRs, not in a single diff. An attacker can spread a side task across PRs (a gradual attack) or wait for the one whose legitimate task provides natural cover (non-gradual attack). No single monitor we test catches both strategies, and this holds across several attack agents and monitor models, reflecting the nature of control in a persistent-state setting rather than something model dependent.

• Compositional suspicion. The side task’s components should ideally be innocuous in isolation but suspicious when combined. A monitor seeing all components in a sin- gle diff should find them far more suspicious than seeing each component introduced gradually across separate, legitimately motivated PRs. This provides the theoretical ad- vantage for gradual attacks.

title: EcoTable: Cost-effective Table Integration in Data Lakes for Natural Language Queries

gold_answer: EcoTable的核心方法是一个基于自然语言的、成本高效的数据集成框架。它利用大语言模型的语义理解和复杂推理能力，通过图结构框架结合轻量级模型与LLM，优先验证以缩小搜索空间并最小化昂贵的LLM调用，从而自动将数据湖中的表格集成为支持用户自然语言查询的形式。

gold_evidence.text: To address this, we propose EcoTable , the first natural language- based data integration framework. Given a set of user-specified natural language queries, EcoTable automatically integrates the tables into a form that adequately supports the corresponding SQL queries. EcoTable achieves this by leveraging the semantic understanding and complex reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs).
EcoTable uses a graph-based framework, combining lightweight models with LLMs to efficiently narrow the search space and minimize costly LLM calls through prioritized validation.

title: Statistically Indistinguishable, Operationally Distinct: A Formal Barrier for Tabular Foundation Models
question: 作者是如何证明所提方法有效的？
gold_answer: 作者通过构造合法与违规数据库状态对，使其1维和2维列值边际分布的总变差小于0.02，然后利用Le Cam引理证明任何仅基于数值的分类器的贝叶斯误差至少为0.49。实验表明，三种仅基于数值的基线模型（XGBoost、TabICL、TabPFN）的准确率恰好为0.50，而暴露关系值一致性可缩小差距，但只有使用七条可执行规则推导的审计才能达到1.00的分类准确率。

gold_evidence.text: Proposition 1 (Necessity of operational grounding). If ∥ϕk(Plegal) −ϕk(Pillegal)∥TV ≤τ, then any values-only classifier has Bayes error ≥1 2 −τ 2. This is Le Cam’s lemma (Le Cam, 1973; Tsybakov, 2009): two distributions within τ in total variation cannot be dis- tinguished better than 1 2 −τ 2 Bayes error. Our construc- tion enforces τ < 0.02 (Section 3), giving ≥0.49.

Three values- only baselines (XGBoost, TabICL, TabPFN) hit the bound exactly (accuracy 0.50, pre-registered two one-sided tests (TOST) p < 0.002), raw row- level access does not help, exposing relational value consistency closes most of the gap, and only a classifier fed by seven executable rule-derived audits reaches 1.00 classification accuracy.

title: Statistically Indistinguishable, Operationally Distinct: A Formal Barrier for Tabular Foundation Models
question: 这篇论文的主要贡献是什么？
gold_answer: 该论文的主要贡献是提出了操作图灵测试（OTT），通过构造统计上不可区分的合法与违规数据库状态对，证明了仅基于数值的表格基础模型无法对运行系统产生的数据进行推理，必须依赖可执行的规则逻辑（操作基础）才能达到高准确率。

gold_evidence.text: Tabular foundation models cannot reason about data produced by running systems without access to the rules that govern them. We make this statement falsifiable. The Operational Turing Test (OTT) constructs pairs of legal and rule-violating database states whose 1- and 2-way column-value marginals match to a total variation of < 0.02; Le Cam’s lemma then bounds any values-only classifier at ≥0.49 Bayes error.

Three values- only baselines (XGBoost, TabICL, TabPFN) hit the bound exactly (accuracy 0.50, pre-registered two one-sided tests (TOST) p < 0.002), raw row- level access does not help, exposing relational value consistency closes most of the gap, and only a classifier fed by seven executable rule-derived audits reaches 1.00 classification accuracy.

gold_answer: Mandol在LoCoMo和LongMemEval两个基准测试上均取得了最佳整体准确率。在LoCoMo上，Mandol在GPT-4o-mini下将最强基线提升了3.35个百分点，达到89.48%准确率；在GPT-4.1-mini下提升了0.24个百分点，达到92.21%准确率。在LongMemEval上，Mandol在GPT-4o-mini下将最强基线提升了7.20个百分点，达到85.00%准确率；在GPT-4.1-mini下提升了5.40个百分点，达到88.40%准确率。此外，Mandol在延迟方面表现优异，在服务器设置下搜索P99、P90和平均延迟均为最佳，且完成LoCoMo工作负载仅需86.18秒，比对比系统快4.2–9.9倍。Mandol还比EverMemOS减少17.4%–20.0%的token使用量。

On LongMemEval, Mandol improves the strongest baseline by 7.20 percentage points under GPT-4o-mini and by 5.40 percentage points under GPT-4.1-mini, reaching 85.00% and 88.40% overall accuracy, respectively.

title: Mandol: An Agglomerative Agent Memory System for Long-Term Conversations
question: 这篇论文的主要贡献是什么？
gold_answer: 本文提出了Mandol，一种用于长期对话的聚合记忆系统。其主要贡献包括：提出层次化记忆模型，通过结构化语义图统一表示基本记忆和抽象记忆；设计聚合语义数据结构，融合键值、向量和图结构，提供统一的混合检索算子；提出定量查询机制，包括查询自适应路由、定量去噪与冲突解决以及令牌约束上下文生成，且检索过程不调用大语言模型。实验表明，Mandol在LoCoMo和LongMemEval基准上取得了最高准确率，并在10 QPS并发下实现了5.4倍的检索加速和4.8倍的插入加速。

(3) a quantitative query mechanism with query-adaptive routing, quantitative denoising and conflict resolution, and token-constrained context generation, all without involving LLMs during retrieval.

Compared to representative open-source memory systems, including Mem0, Zep, MemU [33], MemOS, and EverMemOS [14], Mandol achieves the highest overall accuracy on LoCoMo (92.21%) and LongMemEval (88.40%). It also obtains the best system performance: under a 10 QPS concurrent serving setting, Mandol reduces Search mean latency by 5.4× and Add mean latency by 4.8× over the fastest baselines.

title: CLIP: Lightweight Cosine-Law-Based Inverted-List Pruning for IVF-Based Vector Search
question: 这篇论文提出的核心方法是什么？
gold_answer: 本文提出的核心方法是CLIP，一种基于余弦定律的轻量级倒排列表剪枝技术，用于IVF向量搜索。该方法通过余弦定律推导出下界，实现高效的剪枝，并在此基础上开发了IVF-CLIP和HIVF-CLIP两种增强变体，分别支持平面和层次化IVF结构。此外，还提出了LSM-IVF，将CLIP与LSM树结合，以支持动态更新并保持高查询性能。

gold_evidence.text: This paper presents CLIP, a lightweight cosine-law-based pruning technique for IVF-based vector search.
Building on CLIP, we develop two enhanced IVF variants, i.e., IVF-CLIP and HIVF-CLIP, based on the standard IVFFlat and the common hierarchical IVF method (HIVF) [10, 34], respectively.
We further propose LSM-IVF, which integrates CLIP with an LSM-tree to enable efficient updates while maintaining high query performance.

title: CLIP: Lightweight Cosine-Law-Based Inverted-List Pruning for IVF-Based Vector Search
question: 作者是如何证明所提方法有效的？
gold_answer: 作者通过实验对比和性能指标来证明所提方法的有效性。在静态数据集上，IVF-CLIP和HIVF-CLIP相比基线方法实现了高达78%的剪枝率和69%的效率提升；在磁盘驻留设置下，IVF-CLIP在0.99召回率时比IVFFlat的QPS高34.2%、I/O低22.5%，剪枝率超过65%。此外，LSM-IVF在动态工作负载下吞吐量提升高达141%。

gold_evidence.text: Figure 17 compares IVF-CLIP with disk-based baselines (i.e., SPANN and IVFFlat) on the 1-billion-scale SIFT dataset. IVF-CLIP consistently outperforms both baselines across all recall levels. At 0.99 recall, it achieves 34.2% higher QPS and 22.5% lower I/O than IVFFlat.

Extensive experiments show that CLIP variants achieve up to 78% pruning and 69% higher efficiency over static IVF baselines, while LSM-IVF improves throughput by up to 141% over dynamic IVF baselines with comparable update efficiency.
The pruning ratio of CLIP exceeds 65% at 0.99 recall, demonstrating that IVF-CLIP remains effective at billion scale under disk-resident settings.

title: CLIP: Lightweight Cosine-Law-Based Inverted-List Pruning for IVF-Based Vector Search
question: 这篇论文报告了哪些关键实验结果？
gold_answer: 该论文报告了以下关键实验结果：在静态工作负载下，IVF-CLIP和HIVF-CLIP在所有数据集上均实现了最高的QPS-召回率权衡，IVF-CLIP在SIFT、GloVe、Deep、Tiny、MSong和GIST数据集上平均QPS分别超过最强基线23.4%、46.7%、20.5%、11.5%、5.8%和29.4%，HIVF-CLIP在此基础上进一步提升了11%、15%、14%、7%、10%和20%。参数敏感性实验表明，当切片数p=20时，大多数数据集可达到接近稳定的剪枝性能；设置β=0.001可在效率和准确性之间取得良好折衷。

gold_evidence.text: On average, IVF-CLIP outperforms the strongest baseline in QPS by 23.4%, 46.7%, 20.5%, 11.5%, 5.8%, and 29.4% on SIFT, GloVe, Deep, Tiny, MSong, and GIST, respectively. Building on this, HIVF-CLIP further improves over IVF-CLIP by an additional 11%, 15%, 14%, 7%, 10%, and 20% on average across the six datasets.
In practice, p=20 is sufficient to achieve near-stable pruning performance for most datasets.
Overall, setting β=0.001 provides a good trade-off between efficiency and accuracy, achieving high recall while maintaining high pruning effectiveness.

title: CLIP: Lightweight Cosine-Law-Based Inverted-List Pruning for IVF-Based Vector Search
question: 这篇论文的主要贡献是什么？
gold_answer: 本文提出了CLIP，一种基于余弦定律的轻量级剪枝技术，支持簇间和簇内剪枝，以减少不必要的簇和向量访问。在此基础上，开发了两种IVF变体：IVF-CLIP和HIVF-CLIP，分别支持平面和层次化IVF结构。针对动态工作负载，提出了LSM-IVF，一种受LSM树启发的设计，通过将索引维护推迟到后台合并来实现高效更新，并利用CLIP优化消除冗余搜索。实验表明，CLIP变体在静态IVF基线上实现了高达78%的剪枝和69%的效率提升，而LSM-IVF在动态IVF基线上吞吐量提升高达141%。

gold_evidence.text: This paper proposes CLIP, a lightweight cosine-law–based pruning technique that supports both inter- and intra-cluster pruning, substantially reducing unnecessary cluster and vector accesses with negligible overhead.

This paper presents CLIP, a lightweight cosine-law-based pruning technique for IVF-based vector search. We theoretically establish its correctness and pruning effectiveness, and develop two IVF variants, IVF-CLIP and HIVF-CLIP, to support both flat and hierarchical IVF structures. We further propose LSM-IVF, which integrates CLIP with an LSM-tree to enable efficient updates while maintaining high query performance.

Extensive experiments show that CLIP variants achieve up to 78% pruning and 69% higher efficiency over static IVF baselines, while LSM-IVF improves throughput by up to 141% over dynamic IVF baselines with comparable update efficiency.

title: MaDI-Bench: An End-to-End Data Integration Benchmark
question: 这篇论文提出的核心方法是什么？

gold_evidence.text: This paper introduced the Mannheim Data Integration Benchmark (MaDI-Bench). The benchmark models the full complexity of the data integration process, including schema matching, value normalization, entity matching, and conflict resolution, while at the same time taking into account the dependencies between the subtasks.
To prevent a quick saturation of the benchmark as agentic systems progress, we introduce a generic variant-generation method for deriving harder as well as easier variants from the base tasks.

MaDI-Bench contributes (i) a set of base end-to-end data integration tasks spanning several application domains, each requiring the full schema matching, value normalization, entity matching, and conflict resolution pipeline; and (ii) a generic method for deriving task variants that mitigates rapid benchmark saturation as data integration systems advance.

title: Are Performance-Optimization Benchmarks Reliably Measuring Coding Agents?
question: 这篇论文存在哪些局限性或未来工作方向？
gold_answer: 论文的局限性包括：1）重放和指标计算可能受实现选择、硬件变化和发布工件质量的影响；2）当前基准测试的分数不应直接视为智能体能力的标签，因为参考补丁证据可能因机器而异，尤其是运行时增益接近零时；3）未来基准测试应增加诊断层，包括热点定位、模糊优化目标、对未完全可见工作负载的验证，以及除单一运行时间外的资源指标。未来工作方向是设计更难的流程：找到瓶颈、选择合理的优化、在正确的代码路径上实现优化，并证明其改进了重要的工作负载。

gold_evidence.text: Future benchmarks should preserve executable replay while adding this diagnostic layer: hotspot localization from profiles or traces, ambiguous optimization targets, validation against workloads not fully visible during patch search, and resource metrics beyond one runtime number.

The goal is not to discard today's benchmarks, but to make the next ones test a harder workflow: finding the bottleneck, choosing a justified optimization, implementing it across the right code paths, and proving that it improves the workload that matters.

Leaderboard scores are useful, but our results show that current benchmark scores should not be read as direct labels of agent capability. RQ1 shows that reference-patch evidence can change across machines, especially when the runtime gain is close to zero.

title: RepoRescue: An Empirical Study of LLM Agents on Whole-Repository Compatibility Rescue
question: 作者是如何证明所提方法有效的？
gold_answer: 作者通过构建包含193个Python仓库和122个Java仓库的基准测试RepoRescue，并设计三个阶段（历史环境验证、现代环境验证、源文件修复审计）来证明方法有效。具体地，他们要求每个仓库在其历史环境中通过测试，在现代环境中失败，然后由LLM代理进行修复，并通过源文件审计和实际使用检查来验证修复是否真正反映了源代码的适配。此外，作者还通过后验源文件评估、运行时阻断源文件评估以及场景和漏洞探测（RQ4）来进一步验证修复的有效性。

gold_evidence.text: The benchmark must establish three facts: the repository once worked, modernization breaks the same repository, and a passing repair reflects source adaptation. The rest of the paper makes these facts observable through historical and modern environment validation, source-only auditing, and realistic-use checks for rescues whose historical suite passes.

Post-hoc source-only evaluation is the test-edit-removal rerun described above. Runtime-blocked source-only evaluation prevents test writes, dependency-specification edits, and package installation during the session, asking how the same agent behaves when the shortcut path is unavailable.
RQ4 adds scenario and bug-hunt probes because Phase 2 PASS establishes suite restoration, not semantic correctness.

title: RepoRescue: An Empirical Study of LLM Agents on Whole-Repository Compatibility Rescue
question: 这篇论文的主要贡献是什么？
gold_answer: 本文的主要贡献包括三个方面：第一，提出了一个用于兼容性救援的基准测试RepoRescue，包含193个Python仓库和122个Java仓库，并设计了验证协议确保每个任务从历史工作代码开始，在环境现代化后失败，并在原始测试命令下评估。第二，对部署的LLM智能体进行了实证研究，通过965次Python主试验、386次Python强制重运行和366次Java试验，测量了智能体恢复兼容性的频率、测试编辑对成功的影响以及不同系统解决互补仓库的情况。第三，分析了救援难度和实际可用性，按推理级别（L1-L4）标记成功修复，验证了34个未维护Python仓库的救援结果，并分析了108个Java救援结果以展示静态类型如何暴露捷径危害。

gold_evidence.text: This paper makes three contributions: 1. A benchmark for compatibility rescue. RepoRescue contains 193 Python repositories (47 unmaintained and 146 time-travel, the latter carrying maintainer ground-truth fixes) and 122 unmaintained Java repositories. Its validation protocol checks that each task starts from historically working code, fails after the runtime or dependency environment is modernized, and is then evaluated under the original test command. 2. An empirical study of deployed LLM agents. We run 965 Python primary trials, 386 Python enforced re-runs, and 366 Java trials to measure how often agents restore compatibility, how much apparent success depends on test edits, and where different systems solve complementary repositories. 3. An analysis of rescue difficulty and practical usability. We label successful repairs by reasoning level (L1–L4, κ=0.76), validate 34 unmaintained Python rescues beyond the original suite, and analyze 108 Java rescue outcomes to show how static typing exposes shortcut harm.

title: IonSense-QKG: A Quantum-Readiness Metadata Framework for Lithium-Ion Battery Dataset Discovery
question: 这篇论文提出的核心方法是什么？
gold_answer: 这篇论文提出的核心方法是IonSense-QKG，一个用于锂离子电池数据集发现的量子就绪元数据框架。该框架从EV-Battery-IonSense出发，用量子相关注释丰富公共电池数据集元数据，包括任务类型、模态、序列结构、标签可用性、预处理需求、候选量子编码、估计量子比特可行性和量子就绪分数。通过一组数据集发现查询，IonSense-QKG帮助识别哪些公共电池数据集适用于NISQ时代的混合量子机器学习。

gold_evidence.text: This paper introduced IonSense-QKG, a quantum-readiness meta- data framework for lithium-ion battery dataset discovery.

Starting from EV-Battery-IonSense, the proposed framework enriches pub- lic battery dataset metadata with quantum-relevant annotations, including task type, modality, sequence structure, label availability, preprocessing requirements, candidate quantum encodings, esti- mated qubit feasibility, and a Quantum Readiness Score.

Through a set of dataset-discovery queries, IonSense-QKG helps identify which public battery datasets are feasible for NISQ-era hybrid QML, which datasets support quantum time-series encoding, which re- sources are suitable for limited-label anomaly/failure detection, and which modalities are most promising for quantum feature maps.

title: IonSense-QKG: A Quantum-Readiness Metadata Framework for Lithium-Ion Battery Dataset Discovery
question: 这篇论文的主要贡献是什么？
gold_answer: 本文的主要贡献包括三个方面：第一，提出了一个量子就绪元数据模式，用于电池数据集发现，扩展了已有的锂离子电池数据集索引，增加了与知识图谱兼容的元数据字段；第二，定义了一个启发式的量子就绪评分（QRS），用于候选数据集的选择和优先级排序；第三，展示了一个查询工作负载，通过SQL风格的查询来识别适合NISQ时代混合量子机器学习、量子时间序列编码以及有限标签异常/故障检测的数据集。

gold_evidence.text: We make three contributions: (1) A quantum-ready metadata schema for battery dataset discovery. We extend a curated lithium-ion battery dataset index with knowledge-graph-compatible metadata fields covering tasks, modalities, labels, sequence types, access status, preprocessing requirements, and candidate quantum encodings. (2) A heuristic Quantum Readiness Score for candidate selection. We define a transparent scoring rubric that estimates the practical feasibility of using a dataset in NISQ-era hybrid quantum–classical experiments. (3) A query workload for quantum battery dataset discovery. We demonstrate SQL-style queries over enriched metadata to identify datasets suitable for NISQ-feasible hybrid QML, quantum time-series encoding, and limited-label anomaly/failure detection.
This paper introduced IonSense-QKG, a quantum-readiness meta- data framework for lithium-ion battery dataset discovery.

title: IonSense-QKG: A Quantum-Readiness Metadata Framework for Lithium-Ion Battery Dataset Discovery
question: 这篇论文存在哪些局限性或未来工作方向？
gold_answer: 该框架存在以下局限性：第一，量子就绪分数（QRS）是专家定义的、基于元数据的启发式方法，缺乏用于验证的真实标签，应仅作为候选选择分数而非量子优势或下游准确率的预测指标。第二，部分元数据字段因数据集描述不一致而需要人工标注。第三，访问状态和许可可能随时间变化。第四，估计的量子比特需求依赖于预处理选择和模型设计。未来工作应通过将高、中、低就绪度的数据集运行在常见的混合量子流水线上，并测量QRS是否与可行性、运行时间、可重复性和下游性能相关，来验证QRS排名。

gold_evidence.text: First, QRS is an expert-defined, metadata-driven heuristic and does not have ground-truth labels for validation. It should therefore be inter- preted as a candidate-selection score rather than as a predictor of quantum advantage or downstream accuracy. Second, some meta- data fields require manual annotation because dataset descriptions are inconsistent. Third, access status and licensing may change over time. Fourth, estimated qubit requirements depend on pre- processing choices and model design.

Finally, future work should validate the QRS ranking by running selected high-, medium-, and low-readiness datasets through common hybrid quantum pipelines and measuring whether QRS correlates with feasibility, runtime, reproducibility, and downstream performance.

gold_answer: 这篇论文提出的核心方法是使用TRIBE模型，这是一个1B参数的三模态编码器，通过融合冻结的文本、视频和音频基础编码器特征，并利用Transformer结合学习到的受试者嵌入，来预测每个TR的皮层响应。

gold_evidence.text: TRIBE (d’Ascoli et al., 2025) is a 1B-parameter trimodal encoder trained on 500+ hours of fMRI from 700+ individuals. It extracts features from three frozen foundation encoders (Llama- 3.2 (Grattafiori et al., 2024) over the dialogue transcript, V-JEPA2 (Bardes et al., 2024) over video frames, and Wav2Vec-BERT over the soundtrack), temporally aligns them, and fuses them with a Transformer conditioned on a learned subject embedding to predict the per-TR cortical response P ∈RT×V on the fsaverage5 surface (V =20,484 vertices, TR=1 s).

title: Knowledge Over Parameters: Evolving Smart Contract Vulnerability Detection
question: 这篇论文的主要贡献是什么？
gold_answer: 该论文提出了EVOVULN，一个将智能合约漏洞检测从静态推理任务转化为程序性知识演化问题的自动化框架。实验表明，EVOVULN在五种真实漏洞类型上取得了71%的宏平均F1分数，显著优于静态分析、深度学习、基于LLM的方法、零样本LLM和代码智能体基线。最重要的是，演化出的规则具有可移植性，使得轻量级低成本模型能够超越更大的模型。通过消融实验确认了每个组件的贡献，且一次性演化成本低于50美元，EVOVULN提供了一种实用且与模型无关的智能合约漏洞检测方法。

gold_evidence.text: We presented EVOVULN, an automated framework that reformulates smart contract vulnerability detection from a static inference task into a procedural knowledge evolution problem.

Evaluations across five real-world vulnerability types show that EVOVULN achieves a 71% macro F1-score, substantially outperforming static analysis, deep learning-based, LLM-based methods, zero-shot LLM, and code agent baselines.
With ablations confirming the contribution of each component and a one-time evolution cost under $50, EVOVULN offers a practical, model-agnostic approach to smart contract vulnerability detection.

title: Archer: Towards Agentic Review for Compiler Optimizations
question: 这篇论文的主要贡献是什么？
gold_answer: 本文的主要贡献包括：提出了Archer，首个针对编译器优化补丁的智能代码审查框架，专注于语义正确性错误；提出了动态义务构建作为输入侧语义指导，将历史正确性修复提炼为义务；设计了确定性验证守卫作为输出侧证据控制，仅当文本分析转化为可执行、补丁特定的证据时才报告发现；在真实LLVM PR上实现并评估了Archer，在70个开放和328个关闭的PR中发现了51个语义错误。

gold_evidence.text: We present Archer, the first agentic code review framework for compiler optimization patches, targeting semantic correctness bugs beyond generic review comments.

We propose dynamic obligation construction as input-side semantic guidance, distilling historical correctness fixes into obligations that direct the agent toward fragile compiler-optimization semantics.

We design a deterministic validation guard as output-side evidence control, allowing the agent to report a finding only when its textual analysis is converted into executable, patch-specific evidence.

AUF-only and AUF+decay are indistinguishable: once the support is truncated at the first predicted error, re-weighting the surviving positions with exponential decay adds nothing measurable.

title: Rethinking Complexity Metrics for LLM-Integrated Applications: Beyond Source Code
question: 这篇论文的主要贡献是什么？
gold_answer: 这篇论文的主要贡献有三点：第一，首次将软件复杂度度量扩展到LLM集成应用的提示词层面，通过Prompt-as-Specification模型将提示词视为行为规范，从而实现对提示词和源代码的联合定量度量；第二，构建了HECATE静态分析工具，能够跨自然语言和代码层度量复杂度，并基于维度驱动方法从三个已发表的分类学中推导出52个候选度量指标；第三，通过实验验证了10个指标在代码规模之外携带额外信号，并在未见过的仓库上保持泛化能力。

gold_evidence.text: This paper makes three contributions. • An important and hard problem. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to measure software complexity beyond code for LLM-integrated applications, a setting where much of the logic lives in NL prompts. We frame the problem, spell out its three challenges, and give it a formal footing through Prompt-as-Specification. • A tool and a metric-design method. We build HECATE, a static analyzer that measures complexity across the NL and code layers, together with a dimension-driven method that derives 52 candidate metrics from three published taxonomies and validates each one under size control. • Validated and generalizable results. On 118 components with version-control ground truth, we identify 10 metrics that carry signal beyond code size, explain why the other 42 do not, and show that the strongest metrics still hold on unseen repositories.

question: 作者是如何证明所提方法有效的？

gold_evidence.text: In a panel of 802 developers and 196,212 pull requests (January 2024– April 2026), per-capita throughput eventually doubled, reaching 2.09× the pre-mandate baseline in April 2026, among the largest gains reported from a field deployment of AI coding tools to our knowledge. A staggered difference-in-differences design links the within-developer share of this gain to AI adoption and to a further gain that grows with accumulated use, with the mandate acting as a catalyst rather than a direct driver.

Figure 14 reports the pooled AI-adoption event study referenced in Section III-C. Output is flat in the months before a developer’s first AI-tool use and rises only afterward, supporting the parallel-trends assumption on which the causal reading of β1 rests.

The pooled throughput effect of Section IV-A is robust to absorbing organization-wide time shocks, and its sensitivity to estimator choice is itself informative (Table VI). The AI-adoption coefficient on log(Monthly PRs) is +0.354 under our baseline design (Eq. 1, with a single Postt dummy) and +0.201 (p < 0.001) once we replace that dummy with full calendar-month fixed effects that absorb every monthly organization-wide shock—a roughly two-fifths attenuation that still leaves the effect highly significant.

gold_evidence.text: an empirical comparison of Base, SFT, and RL check- points across math, knowledge, science, code, and instruction-following benchmarks

SFT made the model shorter and more consistently Turkish in its reasoning behavior, with large reductions in average response length and thinking exhaustion, but reduced benchmark accu- racy. RL recovered some mathematical performance, especially AIME24 at the best early checkpoint, yet did not uniformly improve all benchmarks and did not exceed the base model on the reported Macro-6 average.
The contribution is therefore best framed as a technically honest Turkish-thinking reasoning pipeline and evaluation, not as a claim of state-of-the-art Turkish reasoning.

title: Robust for the Wrong Reasons: The Representational Geometry of LLM Robustness to Science Skepticism
question: 这篇论文报告了哪些关键实验结果？
gold_answer: 论文报告了三个关键实验结果：第一，LLM面对科学怀疑时表现出三种不同的行为策略——主动断言、表面回避和无回应，且这些差异源于立场而非表面风格。第二，非回应模型未能线性表征怀疑信号，并通过激活修补提供了部分因果证据。第三，鲁棒性不会跨领域或对话轮次迁移，在安全关键领域（如疫苗）甚至可能反转，从而区分了主动鲁棒性与偶然鲁棒性。

gold_evidence.text: First, we characterize a behavioral taxonomy of LLM responses to science skepticism—reactive assertion, surface hedging, and non-response—and validate that the differences are matters of stance, not surface style. Second, we trace these behavioral differences to their representational origin, showing that the non-responsive model fails to linearly represent the skepticism signal, and we provide partial causal evidence via activation patching. Third, we show that robustness does not transfer across domains or turns, that it can reverse in a safety-critical domain, and we synthesize these results into a taxonomy distinguishing active from accidental robustness—with direct consequences for how robustness should be evaluated before deployment.

In vaccines, CORE-F attenuates sharply (+0.049) and MYTH-D reverses (−0.050): faced with a skeptical user, the model’s rebuttal of vaccine myths weakens. In evolution it is essentially non-responsive on facts. That the reversal occurs in the most safety-critical of the three domains is the result we regard as most consequential.

Accidental robustness, of the kind Mistral displays, is a coincidence of representation: it evaporates under a longer conversation or a shifted domain, both of which we observe. Active robustness, of the kind Qwen displays, is a property one might reasonably expect to generalize.

title: Bayesian Sparse Low-Rank Adaptation for Large Language Model Uncertainty Estimation
question: 这篇论文的主要贡献是什么？
gold_answer: 这篇论文的主要贡献包括三个方面：方法论创新，将不确定性量化的范式从密集的LLM参数空间或LoRA适配器空间转移到轻量级的LoRA秩级别，引入最小的计算开销；原则性方法，将理论严谨的变分贝叶斯估计与经验上可靠的集成式推理相结合，经验证明优于类似秩丢弃的方法；全面的实证验证和卓越性能，通过大量实验证明DALorRA在不牺牲推理准确性的情况下显著改善了LLM的校准。

gold_evidence.text: We summarize three primary contributions: • Methodology innovation. We shift the paradigm of uncertainty quantification from the dense LLM param- eter space or LoRA adapter (B and/or A) space to the lightweight LoRA rank level, introducing minimal computational overhead. • Principled Approach. We bridge theoretically rigorous variational Bayesian estimation with empirically sound ensemble-like inference. This principled approach is empirically proven to outperform a rank dropout that similarly induces uncertainty and sparsity over LoRA rank. • Comprehensive empirical validation and excellent performance. We demonstrate through extensive experiments on diverse reasoning benchmarks that DALorRA consistently performs exceptional calibration without sacrificing reasoning accuracy.

We propose DALorRA as a novel parameter-efficient fine-tuning framework for LLM uncertainty quantification. By systematically learning a variational posterior over the LoRA rank components, DALorRA prunes superfluous capacity while effectively capturing epistemic uncertainty. Our comprehensive evaluations across diverse tasks demonstrate that DALorRA significantly improves LLM calibration without sacrificing fundamental reasoning accuracy.

title: Bayesian Sparse Low-Rank Adaptation for Large Language Model Uncertainty Estimation
question: 这篇论文存在哪些局限性或未来工作方向？
gold_answer: 该论文的局限性包括：第一，实证评估目前仅限于固定答案空间的分类式推理任务，未来可扩展到开放生成场景；第二，推理时依赖多个伯努利掩码样本带来额外开销，对延迟敏感应用构成挑战，需开发更高效的推理近似；第三，DALorRA仅在LoRA秩级别建模不确定性，可能遗漏更细粒度的权重级不确定性，未来可集成数据自适应秩掩码与权重级贝叶斯化方法；第四，当前变分后验假设独立的伯努利分解，忽略了秩、层和投影模块间的潜在依赖，开发能捕捉这些复杂架构依赖的结构化变分后验是重要的未来研究方向。

gold_evidence.text: First, our empirical evaluation is currently limited to classification-style reasoning tasks with fixed answer spaces; future work can extend this framework to open-ended generation scenarios where hallucinations and uncertainty are more complex to characterize.

Second, the reliance on multiple Bernoulli mask samples for inference introduces extra overhead, which poses challenges for latency-sensitive applications and necessitates the development of more efficient inference approximations.

Third, because DALorRA models uncertainty solely at the LoRA rank level rather than over full adapter weights, it may miss fine-grained, weight-level uncertainty. To address this, future work could seamlessly integrate our data-adaptive rank masking with more expressive, weight-level Bayesianization approaches. Finally, the current variational posterior assumes an independent Bernoulli factorization that ignores potential dependencies across ranks, layers, and projection modules. Developing structured variational posteriors capable of capturing these complex architectural dependencies remains an important area for future investigation.

gold_answer: 这篇论文的主要贡献是：证明了H-Score目标在无限制函数设置下对可逆变换具有不变性，但在有限宽度近似下会引入基相关的截断误差，从而提出输入预条件方法。具体地，识别出快速傅里叶变换（FFT）作为近似平稳过程的有效、数据无关且低成本的预条件器，并引入基于谱熵和累积依赖能量的无训练度量，用于量化基的适用性并预测下游推理性能。实验表明，FFT预条件在资源受限场景下可实现高达50%的归一化均方误差（NMSE）降低。

gold_evidence.text: We prove that H-Score is invariant to invertible transformations in the unrestricted functional setting, but becomes sensitive to input basis rotations under constrained approximation classes. Consequently, we study unitary preconditioning for H-Score networks and show that selecting an appropriate basis rotation reduces finite-width truncation error by concentrating predictive dependence into fewer dominant modes. We identify the fast Fourier transform (FFT) as an effective data-independent, low-cost preconditioner for approximately stationary processes, where spectral structure induces concentration of the cross-covariance

We introduce training-free metrics based on spectral entropy and cumulative dependence energy to quantify basis suitability and predict downstream inference gains prior to network training. Experiments across eight multivariate datasets demonstrate that FFT preconditioning is particularly useful in resource-constrained regimes, achieving up to 50% normalized mean squared error (NMSE) reduction, while the proposed metrics correlate with observed performance gains and correctly identify cases where spectral preconditioning is detrimental.

question: 这篇论文存在哪些局限性或未来工作方向？

gold_evidence.text: (i) CoFL-S focuses on low-level instruction-to-action control and assumes that a local sub- instruction is available. It does not by itself solve long-horizon route decomposition, exploration, or persistent memory. A natural direction is to pair CoFL-S with a high-level task decomposer, while using the sector field as the execution layer.

(ii) The current field is defined on a two-dimensional camera-centered ground-plane sector. This is effective for ground steering and obstacle-aware mo- tion, but does not explicitly model full 3D collision avoidance or vertical clearance. Extending the representation toward 3D spatial fields is an important future direction.

gold_evidence.text: a key limitation of the OvA classification strategy is that each output unit must learn a complex decision boundary that distinguishes its target class from the union of all remaining classes. For instance, removing classes for disposal channels requires full retraining or, at a minimum, fine-tuning.

the OvR strategy is computationally intensive because it necessitates multiple binary classifiers. Nonetheless, the OvR classification strategy is more modular in managing individual classes. Another notable finding is that only 29 samples were commonly misclassified by both strategies, indicating that future work on a unified architecture combining both strategies could be beneficial. Another potential direction for future work is to use an adaptive threshold by considering it as a hyperparameter to be optimized. To support the circular economy, future work also focuses on applying the experimental framework to the recycling of electronic circuit boards.

long-term progress requires greater harmonization of municipal regulations and infrastructure. Consequently, future initiatives could aim to align these regulations within a unified framework to support reusing resources, improve material recovery, and enable a scalable Circular Economy.

gold_evidence.text: To highlight the scope of the problem and current practices, we explore the use of LLM-as-a-Judge evaluators in ACL Anthology papers focusing on multilingual settings and low-resource languages across a diverse set of tasks.

Our in-depth analysis of these papers indicates inconsistent evaluation outcomes, a tendency to overtrust LLM judgments in multilingual settings, and the widespread reliance on a single judge model per study. title: Aggregation with Exponential Weights is Optimal in Expectation
question: 这篇论文提出的核心方法是什么？
gold_answer: 本文提出的核心方法是聚合指数权重（AEW）估计器，该估计器在温度足够大且固定时，在期望意义下达到最优的聚合速率 T log(M)/(n+1)，其中 M 是字典元素数量，n 是样本量，T 是温度参数。该方法适用于有界、Lipschitz 连续且强凸的损失函数，包括平方损失作为特例。

gold_evidence.text: In this paper, we settle this problem by showing that without requiring a Bernstein-type assumption, the AEW indeed achieves the excess risk T log(M)/(n + 1) in expectation, whenever the temperature T satisfies (L2/T) exp(B/T) ≤µ/2.

In this short paper, we prove that the aggregation with exponential weights estimator achieves the minimax optimal rate of aggregation T log(M)/(n + 1) with respect to M and n, for large enough fixed temperatures T, when the loss is bounded, Lipschitz continuous, and strongly convex.

title: Aggregation with Exponential Weights is Optimal in Expectation

gold_evidence.text: In this paper, we settle this problem by showing that without requiring a Bernstein-type assumption, the AEW indeed achieves the excess risk T log(M)/(n + 1) in expectation, whenever the temperature T satisfies (L2/T) exp(B/T) ≤µ/2.
For squared loss, we show that T ≥4b2 suffices when the predictions and labels are [0, b]-valued.

Because AEW is known to be suboptimal in expectation for temperatures below some constant, this shows that AEW has a sharp phase transition when the temperature is large enough but constant, as conjectured by Lecu´e and Mendelson.

title: ArcAD: Anomaly-Rectified Calibration for Cold-Start Supervised Anomaly Detection
question: 作者是如何证明所提方法有效的？
gold_answer: 作者通过大量实验证明所提方法有效。首先，在四个数据集上的广泛实验表明，ArcAD 能够持续提升 ReContrast、RD4AD 和 Dinomaly 等最先进基线的性能，例如在 Real-IAD 数据集的多类设置下，Image-level AUROC 分别提升 +2.2%、+8.9% 和 +3.7%。其次，消融实验验证了 SPM 和 DGC 模块的各自贡献，去除 DGC 模块导致 I-AUROC 下降 2.3%，表明异常引导的分布校准对修正正常边界至关重要。此外，特征可视化显示，优化后表示被有效约束，形成高度均匀且紧凑的簇。

gold_evidence.text: Extensive experiments on four datasets [1, 8, 43, 55] demonstrate that ArcAD consistently enhances state-of-the-art baselines such as ReContrast [13], RD4AD [5], and Dinomaly [14]. Specifically, under the challenging multi-class setting of the Real-IAD dataset [43], ArcAD achieves Image-level AUROC gains of +2.2%, +8.9%, and +3.7% for these models, respectively.

First, removing the SPM module (Lspm) decreases I-AUROC, P-AUROC, and P-F1-max by 0.8%, 0.1%, and 0.5%, respectively, verifying the necessity of constraining feature uniformity and compactness. Second, removing the DGC module (Ldgc) drops the metrics by 2.3%, 0.2%, and 1.7%, demonstrating that anomaly-guided distribution calibration is crucial for rectifying the normal boundary.

As illustrated in Fig. 6 (right), before optimization, the patch features are randomly and sparsely scattered across the hypersphere. In contrast, after applying our proposed optimization, the representations are effectively constrained, forming highly uniform and compact clusters.

On both the MVTec-AD and VisA, ArcAD achieves the best performance with 99.7%/99.2%/68.9% and 98.9%/99.0%/54.9% (I-AUROC/P-AUROC/P-F1-max), surpassing all SOTA methods.

title: ArcAD: Anomaly-Rectified Calibration for Cold-Start Supervised Anomaly Detection

gold_answer: 本文的主要贡献包括：提出ArcAD，一种通用的即插即用校准框架，用于冷启动场景下的重建模型；引入基于Sinkhorn的原型建模（SPM），将有限的正常样本组织成超球面上紧凑且均匀的簇；提出缺陷引导校准（DGC），通过原型限制的合成策略生成伪异常，利用真实和合成缺陷显式修正潜在空间中的正常边界；在四个数据集上的大量实验表明，ArcAD能够持续提升ReContrast、RD4AD和Dinomaly等最先进基线的性能。

gold_evidence.text: We propose ArcAD, a generic plug-and-play calibration framework for reconstruction based models under cold-start scenarios.
We introduce Sinkhorn-based Prototype Modeling (SPM) to organize limited normal samples into compact and uniform clusters on the hypersphere.

We propose Defect-Guided Calibration (DGC), which introduces a prototype-restricted synthesis strategy to generate pseudo-anomalies, thereby leveraging both real and synthesized defects to explicitly rectify the normal boundary in the latent space.

title: CheckRLM: Effective Knowledge-Thought Coherence Checking in Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning
question: 这篇论文提出的核心方法是什么？
gold_answer: CheckRLM的核心方法包括两个模块：在推理过程中进行知识声明识别（In-Process Knowledge Claim Recognition）和局部知识连贯性修正（Localized Knowledge Coherence Correction）。前者通过提取推理链单元中的事实声明来定位错误位置，后者基于检索文档以最小成本修正事实错误。这两个模块通过DPO（直接偏好优化）进行联合优化。

gold_evidence.text: In-process knowledge claim recognition locates error positions by extracting factual claims from reasoning chain units, while localized knowledge coherence correction corrects factual errors at minimal cost based on retrieved documents. The two modules are jointly optimized using DPO.

In the constrained ablation study, given the high interdependence between the In-Process Knowledge Claim Recognition and Localized Knowledge Coherence Correction modules that prevent their complete removal, we apply the simplest versions of both modules and conduct experiments across various models.

title: HERMES: A Multi-Granularity Labeling Substrate for Pre-training Data Mixtures

question: 作者是如何证明所提方法有效的？

gold_evidence.text: Our study indicates a trend where multi-image augmentations generally yield superior recognition performance, whereas severe geometric transformations often pose risks to vascular topology.

In data-scarce regimes (e.g., the VERA220 dataset with 2,200 images and the FV-USM dataset with 1,476 images), augmentation yields the largest absolute gains in accuracy. On larger datasets (e.g., SCUT1100 dataset with 11,000 images), vanilla baselines are already strong. Yet, augmentation continues to produce meaningful improvements at the harder metrics: MixUp reduces EER from 0.30% to 0.07% and boosts TAR@FAR=0.0001 from 97.30% to 99.63% on SCUT1100, revealing improvements that are invisible to accuracy-centric analysis.

Non-dominated augmentations are assigned Rank-1 APEX, such that no other augmentation can improve one metric without degrading at least one other. By iteratively removing Rank-1 individuals, the subsequent non-dominated sets are defined as Rank-2 and higher. This ranking paradigm classifies methods beyond pure accuracy based on their strategic location on the efficiency-performance frontier and effectively eliminates redundant methods with high computational costs but only marginal performance gains.

title: Dendritic In-Context Learning in a Single-Layer Spiking Neural Network
question: 作者是如何证明所提方法有效的？

gold_evidence.text: DendriCL is the highest-scoring spike-based model and is within 3 pp of its non-spiking ablation DendriCNN, indicating spike binarization itself is not the limiting factor.

Our claim is about the regime past d = 30, where Transformer training fails (grokking or total non-convergence) and DendriCL is the only architecture that both trains stably and reaches a useful fraction of the Bayes ceiling.
Width ablation reveals a sharp upper cliff: dapical ≤384 all work; dapical ≥512 catastrophically fails.

title: Dendritic In-Context Learning in a Single-Layer Spiking Neural Network
question: 这篇论文的主要贡献是什么？
gold_answer: 该论文的主要贡献是提出了DendriCL，一种单层区室化脉冲神经网络，其顶端递归在结构上等同于泄漏在线Widrow-Hoff LMS。在推理时突触权重冻结的情况下，DendriCL能够解决Garg-2022 ICL任务，在d∈{5,...,50}范围内表现良好，并且在d≥30时具有独特的种子稳定性，而密集Transformer在此范围内会出现grokking式双峰分布或失败。此外，该论文通过线性探针揭示了顶端区室动力学是一种不同于基于可塑性和注意力的测试时自适应方法。

gold_evidence.text: We instantiate this in DendriCL: a single-layer compartmental spiking network whose apical recurrence uA(t + 1) = α uA(t) + γ (yt −ˆyt) WA xt is structurally identical to leaky online Widrow–Hoff LMS [Widrow and Hoff, 1960]. Once (α, γ, WA, WB) are trained end-to-end by BPTT, the apical membrane provably tracks the task parameter w, and every synaptic weight is frozen at inference.

On this basis we introduce DendriCL, the first single-layer compartmental SNN to solve general-purpose Garg-2022 ICL across d ∈{5, . . . , 50} where canonical SNN baselines (Spikformer, Pure LIF, LSNN, Spike- driven V2) collapse at d ≥20, and the only architecture that is seed-stable at d ≥30 where dense Transformers exhibit grokking-style bimodality and fail past d=40.
Apical compartmental dynamics are thus a class of test-time adaptation distinct from plasticity- and attention-based approaches.

title: Generalization in offline RL: The structure is more important than the amount of pessimism
question: 这篇论文提出的核心方法是什么？
gold_answer: 该论文提出的核心方法是通过数据增强（DA）在策略提取阶段施加一致性损失，而非在常规离线训练中对增强数据集进行训练。具体而言，论文提出了DAC方法，包括DAC-Latent、DAC-Output以及结合两者的DAC-AC变体，通过在价值学习或策略提取中添加一致性损失来利用对称性。

gold_evidence.text: Inspired by our theoretical results, we argue that DA can best be applied through a consistency loss during policy extraction, rather than the common practice of (regular) offline training on an augmented dataset.

For the DAC-Latent and DAC-Output experiments we again perform a small search over the consistency coefficient values {1, 10, 100} and choose the best ones. For the -C variant, the consistency loss is added to the state and Q value learning, implemented a an MSE loss on the last hidden layer or on the state/Q value output of the networks. The -A variant adds the consistency loss on policy during policy extraction, which is implemented as an MSE loss on the last hidden layer or the logits over actions. The -AC variant adds the consistency loss to both the value learning and policy extraction.

Subset-replace Strategy: Initially, a reference set is generated using the diffusion policy. During rollout, a random subset is replaced with newly generated samples in the same classes. question: 这篇论文报告了哪些关键实验结果？
gold_answer: 论文报告了以下关键实验结果：在Heisenberg J1–J2链上，PWO优化器在不同模型规模下均表现出稳定性和单调能量改进，而minSR不稳定且无法达到有竞争力的能量值；Adam在小型网络上表现最佳，但在中大型网络上稳定性和效率下降，达到中等NQS能量所需时间约为PWO的4倍。在1.5B参数RWKV-7模型对横向场Ising模型的微调中，PWO相比Adam获得了更低的最终相对误差和V-score，且训练更稳定。

gold_evidence.text: PWO exhibits consistent stability and monotonic energy improvement as NQS size grows, reaching near-final energies within the first 30 minutes. In contrast, minSR is both unstable and never reaches competitive energy values. Adam performs best for the tiny network, but degrades in stability and efficiency for small and medium NQS, where PWO is both faster and more reliable. In particular, achieving comparable energy scales with the medium NQS requires roughly 4× more time with Adam than with PWO.
PWO achieves a lower final relative error and V-score than Adam, while maintaining stable training across the full wall-clock budget.

title: One More Time: Revisiting Neural Quantum States from a Reinforcement Learning Perspective
question: 这篇论文的主要贡献是什么？

gold_evidence.text: We introduced Proximal Wavefunction Optimization (PWO), a scalable first-order optimizer for neural quantum states (NQS) derived from an explicit connection between variational Monte Carlo and reinforcement learning (RL).

In the fixed-phase stoquastic setting, we showed that variational energy minimization can be written as an advantage policy-gradient objective over the Born distribution, where spin configurations play the role of actions and centered local energies act
a PPO-style proximal objective can retain the low wall-clock cost of first-order optimization while providing the stability needed to train expressive NQS on difficult quantum Hamiltonians.

title: One More Time: Revisiting Neural Quantum States from a Reinforcement Learning Perspective
question: 这篇论文存在哪些局限性或未来工作方向？
gold_answer: 论文的局限性包括：PWO的理论是局部和保守的，依赖于共同支撑和有界性假设，不能保证神经网络训练的全局收敛；实验仅涵盖一维链、受挫二维方格和RWKV微调，尚未构成跨哈密顿量族的全面NQS基准；在更大二维系统、费米子模型和电子结构问题上的验证仍待开展。此外，PWO引入了额外的优化超参数（如振幅和相位裁剪阈值、内部轮数），其最优值可能依赖于哈密顿量、ansatz、系统大小和样本预算。

gold_evidence.text: Although PWO is supported by a first-order consistency result and a clipped improvement bound, the theory remains local and conservative: it relies on common-support and boundedness assumptions and does not imply global convergence for neural-network training.

Empirically, our results include one-dimensional chains, a frustrated two-dimensional square lattice, and a large-scale RWKV fine-tuning experiment, but they are still not a comprehensive NQS benchmark across Hamiltonian families.

In particular, broader validation on larger two-dimensional systems, fermionic models, and electronic-structure problems remains open. Finally, PWO introduces additional optimization hyperparameters, such as amplitude and phase clipping thresholds and the number of inner epochs, whose optimal values may depend on the Hamiltonian, ansatz, system size, and sample budget.

question: 这篇论文存在哪些局限性或未来工作方向？
gold_answer: 论文的局限性包括：内部有效性方面，意图提取和判断均使用GPT-4o-mini，无法完全排除模型自身的判断偏差；阈值δmin、θ和δsev固定设置，实际采用时需根据风险容忍度重新校准。构造有效性方面，基于计划的测试只能检查计划与行动是否一致，无法验证计划是否真实反映执行行为，存在被故意欺骗的智能体规避检测的风险。外部有效性方面，市场仅含196个技能，更大或更具对抗性的社区市场可能呈现不同的合约几何结构；实际部署还需考虑查询预算与推理成本的权衡，以及技能更新后的重新筛查。未来工作方向包括：在更大规模或对抗性市场中进行验证，优化成本-准确度权衡，以及处理技能更新后的重新筛查问题。

gold_evidence.text: Internal validity: Our intent extraction and judgment both use GPT-4o-mini, excluded from the plan-agent pool to avoid self-evaluation, though residual judge bias of model itself cannot be fully ruled out. The thresholds δmin, θ, and δsev are fixed once across all tasks and agents rather than tuned per target, keeping cross-model and cross-strategy comparisons on equal footing, though a marketplace operator adopting SKILLFUZZ would still need to calibrate these thresholds to their own risk tolerance rather than reuse ours directly.

Construct validity: Plan-based testing is inherently limited to whether an agent’s plan aligns with its action. Any text- based oracle, including ours, can only reason over the agent’s declared intent and has no way to verify that this declaration matches what the agent would actually do once a tool executes. An agent capable of stating an innocuous plan while pursuing a different objective during execution would produce a low plan drift and evade detection entirely, since the discrepancy would never surface in the text under test.

External validity: Our marketplace has 196 skills, and a larger or more adversarial community marketplace could exhibit a different contract geometry, potentially shifting which co-activations the pruning step retains as candidates. A de- ployed admission gate would also need to decide a query budget B against real inference cost, a cost-accuracy tradeoff our fixed-budget evaluation does not directly model, and would need to re-screen co-activations as skills in the marketplace are updated or revised after admission.

gold_evidence.text: Model scope: The frame-dependence mechanism may vary across architectures (e.g., Llama, Gemini) and model scales. While we hypothesize it is inherent to autoregressive generation, this requires cross-architectural verification.

Combining the preferred choices yields improved RDM (iRDM): it sets the one-step state of the art on ImageNet at SWr14 1.30, corroborated by PickScore, a human-preference proxy our objective never optimizes, which prefers it over the prior best one-step generator on 71.2% of matched samples. title: Hardware-Enforced Semantic Coordination for Safety-Critical Real-Time Autonomous Systems
question: 这篇论文提出的核心方法是什么？
gold_answer: 该论文提出的核心方法是一种硬件强制的语义协调架构，将选定的协调语义直接通过现场可编程门阵列（FPGA）在硬件层面实现。该方法基于主题通信空间Petri网（TB-CSPN）框架，将选定的TB-CSPN协调机制映射到FPGA原语上，创建一个硬件原生的语义协调层，重点在于强制执行时间同步、语义门控、授权约束和有界协调行为，而语义推理仍保持自适应和软件驱动。

gold_evidence.text: we propose a hardware-enforced semantic coordination architecture in which selected coordination semantics are implemented directly at the hardware level via field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs). The approach builds on the Topic-Based Communication Space Petri Net (TB–CSPN) framework, which separates semantic reasoning from interaction management. In this approach, selected TB–CSPN coordination mechanisms are mapped onto FPGA primitives, creating a hardware-native semantic coordination layer.

Focus is not on acceleration, but on enforcing temporal synchronization, semantic gating, authorization constraints, and bounded coordination behavior directly in hardware. Semantic reasoning remains adaptive and software-driven, while embedded coordination semantics become deterministic.

gold_evidence.text: TGO-II: Representation Geometry Observatory continues the Transformer Geometry Observatory (TGO) framework by analyzing the representational dynamics of Vision Transform- ers throughout supervised training. While TGO-I investigated the evolution of covariance spectra and feature-space geom- etry, TGO-II focused on representation similarity, intrinsic dimensionality, and token interaction structure. Using Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA), Singular Vector Canonical Cor- relation Analysis (SVCCA), Two-Nearest Neighbor Intrinsic Dimensionality (TwoNN-ID), and token covariance analysis, several consistent patterns were observed.

The primary objective of TGO-II is to investigate three questions: 1) Do spectrally similar layers correspond to representa- tionally similar layers? 2) How does the intrinsic dimensionality of transformer representations evolve throughout training? 3) Is increasing representational complexity driven by pro- gressive token independence or by increasingly sophis- ticated transformations of strongly coupled token sys- tems?

gold_answer: 论文报告了以下关键实验结果：第一，使用CKA和SVCCA观察到表示相似性在整个训练过程中逐渐下降，表明Transformer层逐渐变得专业化。第二，内在维度在训练初期快速增加然后收敛，表明表示流形逐渐占据更丰富的局部自由度。第三，token协方差分析显示强token交互结构在整个训练过程中持续存在，表明表示复杂性的增加并非伴随token完全独立。第四，相邻层在收敛时保持强对齐，最小相似性出现在第4层和第5层之间。第五，内在维度的演化与TGO-I中观察到的协方差谱扩展定性一致，支持流形扩展假说。

gold_evidence.text: Both CKA and SVCCA exhibited a progressive decrease throughout training, indicating that Transformer layers become increasingly specialized as optimization proceeds. Simultaneously, intrinsic dimensionality increased across the network before converging, suggesting that the learned representation manifold progressively occupies a richer set of locally accessible degrees of freedom. Furthermore, token covariance analysis demonstrated that strong token interaction structure persists throughout the entire training process.

The adjacent-layer evaluation demonstrates that neighboring layers remain strongly aligned at convergence. The minimum similarity is observed between Layers 4 and 5, whereas Layers 6 through 12 exhibit consistently high representational similarity.

Throughout training, intrinsic dimensionality increases rapidly before converging, closely mirroring the evolution of Effective Rank and other spectral observables measured on feature covariance matrices. This observation motivates the Manifold Expansion Hypothesis.

title: Transformer Geometry Observatory TGO-II: Representational Similarity Observatory
question: 这篇论文存在哪些局限性或未来工作方向？
gold_answer: 该论文的局限性包括：TGO-II没有直接测量表示中的语义内容或任务特定信息，因此提出的过渡假说应仅视为表示几何的变化，而非语义处理的确定性证据。未来工作方向包括：通过语义几何观测站（TGO-III）使用线性探针、类别分离分析等方法研究语义结构的出现；通过令牌动力学观测站（TGO-IV）分析令牌级动态，如余弦相似度、令牌轨迹可视化等；通过注意力几何观测站（TGO-V）研究注意力熵、头专业化、路由行为等；通过优化几何观测站（TGO-VI）研究梯度几何、Hessian谱等优化景观。

gold_evidence.text: TGO- II does not directly measure semantic content or task-specific information encoded within the representations. Consequently, the proposed transition should be interpreted as a change in representational geometry rather than definitive evidence of semantic processing.

Future work will therefore investigate the emergence of semantic structure through lin- ear probing, class-separation analysis, nearest-neighbor purity, Fisher discriminant analysis, and label alignment.

Future observatories will there- fore investigate token-level dynamics using cosine similarity, token trajectory visualization, token drift, local manifold anal- ysis, neighborhood preservation, and temporal token evolution.

title: DecompRL: Solving Harder Problems by Learning Modular Code Generation
question: 这篇论文提出的核心方法是什么？
gold_answer: DecompRL是一种强化学习技术，它直接训练模型进行分层推理，通过将编程问题分解为更简单的子问题并重新组合成完整解决方案，从而提升模型在复杂编程任务上的表现。该方法使用新颖的log-mean-exp优势函数直接优化混合的pass@k目标，鼓励多样性，并利用重组解决常规RL训练无法解决的问题。

gold_evidence.text: We introduce DecompRL, a reinforcement learning technique that directly trains models for hierarchical inference, greatly enhancing their performance on this task.
This method encourages diversity by directly optimizing for a mixture of pass@k objectives with a novel logmeanexp advantage function.
The resulting models use recombination to solve problems unreachable with regular RL training.

gold_evidence.text: For instance, Qwen 3 8B requires the ablation of at least three directions to surpass a 50% ASR threshold.

Ablation must target refusal mechanisms without inducing catastrophic forgetting or degrading general reasoning capabilities.

gold_answer: 该论文的主要贡献是提出了Q-GAIN，一个用于构建可复用的机器学习和统计分析工作流的模块化Python框架。该框架通过可扩展的Detector和Controller接口，将工作流基础设施与领域特定分析模块分离，使得科学分析流程能够适应、扩展和跨多种应用场景复用。框架提供了数据管理、预处理、ML训练与推理、下游统计分析、可视化和导出的共享基础设施。

gold_evidence.text: We have presented Q-GAIN, a modular Python framework for constructing reusable ML and statistical-analysis workflows for scientific imaging applications.

The framework provides shared infrastructure for data management, preprocessing, ML training and inference, downstream statistical analysis, visualization, and export, while allowing application-specific analysis logic to be incorporated through extensible Detector and Controller interfaces.
By separating workflow infrastructure from domain-specific analysis modules, Q-GAIN enables scientific-analysis pipelines to be adapted, extended, and reused across a broad range of applications.

gold_evidence.text: We formulate intent-aware camera motion generation, where an embodied agent predicts a relative SE(3) target camera pose from the current observation and a free-form intent.
We introduce LIME, a vision-language camera-motion generator trained from egocentric video frame pairs with mined intents, observation-gain descriptions, and relative camera poses.

Through experiments on a constructed benchmark and downstream tasks, we demonstrate that our learned intent-aware model is effective across tasks with diverse granularities and benefits downstream applications.

title: Wavelet-Guided Semantic Signal Compensation for Inversion-Free Image Editing
question: 这篇论文的主要贡献是什么？
gold_answer: 本文的主要贡献包括：第一，识别并分析了在整流流模型下无反转编辑的一个局限性，即在高噪声区域中语义编辑信号因流形追寻流的主导而变弱，限制了全局属性变化所需的定向偏差积累；第二，提出了一种基于小波的语义信号补偿机制，该机制提取低频细节系数，通过时间调制更新规则注入编辑流中，在早期结构形成阶段提供最大引导，并在纹理细化阶段二次衰减以保持保真度。

gold_evidence.text: We identify and analyze a limitation of inversion-free editing under rectified flow models, where the semantic editing signal becomes weak in high-noise regimes due to the dominance of manifold-seeking flow. We show that this effect limits the accumulation of directional deviation required for global attribute changes.

We propose a wavelet-based semantic signal compensation mechanism that extracts low-frequency detail coefficients. This prior is injected into the editing flow via a time-modulated update rule, ensuring maximum guidance during the early structural formation phase while quadratically decaying to preserve fidelity during the textural refinement phase.

title: Wavelet-Guided Semantic Signal Compensation for Inversion-Free Image Editing

gold_evidence.text: However, we observe that under certain global attribute shifts, the editing trajectory may not effectively move away from the source distribution in the early timesteps. Our analysis suggests that in the high-noise regime, the dominant manifold-seeking flow toward the data manifold can reduce the influence of the text-conditioned direction, leading to limited global modification while background structures remain only moderately preserved.

Inspired by this observation, we propose an inversion-free, frequency-aware semantic compensation strategy that strengthens the effective signal in the early stage of generation, while maintaining structural consistency in the background. The proposed method improves global editing capacity without sacrificing background fidelity.

Motivated by this analysis, we introduced a time-dependent compensation mechanism that enhances semantic deviation when the trajectory is insufficiently responsive to the target prompt, while remaining compatible with the original formulation. The proposed strategy improves editing strength while maintaining background fidelity.

title: WorldSample: Closed-loop Real-robot RL with World Modelling
question: 这篇论文报告了哪些关键实验结果？
gold_answer: 论文报告了以下关键实验结果：在接触密集和精密操作任务上，WorldSample相比基线方法提高了成功率、加快了收敛速度并减少了真实交互成本。具体地，在Pushing、Insertion和Sorting任务上，WorldSample显著提升了成功率和训练时间趋势；在Pick&Place和Assemble任务上，WorldSample实现了更高的成功率，同时时间成本与基线相当。消融实验表明，Policy-Paced Learning（PPL）中的不确定性引导调度和Q感知样本选择对稳定训练至关重要：去除调度导致成功率从95%降至61%，去除Q感知选择使成功率降至76%并增加干预率。

gold_evidence.text: Experiments on contact-rich and precision manipulation tasks show improved success, faster convergence, and reduced real interaction cost over baselines.

On Pushing, Insertion, and Sorting, WorldSample significantly improves both success and training time trends. On Pick&Place and Assemble, WorldSample achieves substantially higher success, while the time cost remains comparable to HIL-SERL due to the increased difficulty of long-horizon contact-rich execution.

Removing uncertainty-guided scheduling reduces success from 95% to 61%, showing that synthetic data should not be naively introduced throughout online training, as visual hallucination can lead to noisy policy capability. Removing Q-aware sample selection also degrades performance to 76% success and increases intervention rate to 42%.

gold_evidence.text: Despite the strong performance of MARVEL, a few limitations remain. Firstly, the framework relies on auxiliary OOD data for training the outlier expert, and its effectiveness may depend on the diversity and representativeness of these samples. Further, a common limitation of OOD methods arises from the assumption of a fixed and well-defined label space.

Future directions of this work include exploring an even wider range of distribution shifts for various imaging modalities and improving the interpretability of OOD decisions, for instance, by identifying the features or regions that contribute to OOD prediction; recent advances in foundation models and vision-language models offer a promising direction for such explanations. Further work would involve extending the approach to dense prediction tasks, such as segmentation, to broaden its applicability to more complex workflows.

question: 这篇论文的主要贡献是什么？
gold_answer: 该论文的主要贡献包括五个方面：第一，在固定模型和推理努力的情况下，对视觉自动化和测试工具进行了匹配的重复对比；第二，首次在同一模型中对比了高和极高推理努力的效果；第三，测量了相同运行中的视觉质量，分离了设计提示对外观和功能的影响；第四，通过标准层级分析揭示了失败发生的位置、失败模式在模型代际间的变化以及聚合分数掩盖的差异；第五，进行了提示消融实验，发现一段简短的提示即可复现完整的设计提升效果。

gold_evidence.text: This study makes five contributions. The first is a matched, replicated contrast for a visual automation and testing tool, holding model and effort fixed, at two capability tiers. The second is the first effort contrast in this dataset, comparing High and xHigh reasoning effort on a model that exposes both. The third is a measurement of visual quality across the same runs, which separates the effect of a design prompt on appearance from its effect on function. The fourth is a criterion level analysis of the same runs, which shows where failures occur, how failure modes shift between model generations, and why aggregate scores understate those shifts; the same per run session records support a decomposition of what each added capability actually spends tokens on. The fifth is a prompt ablation: a one paragraph design directive

A design oriented prompt raised visual quality, 4.5 versus 3.0 on a 5 point scale, without lifting function, and a one paragraph paraphrase of its design directive reproduced the entire lift, showing the capability needs only invocation.

question: 这篇论文存在哪些局限性或未来工作方向？
gold_answer: 该研究存在以下局限性：1. 仅使用单一任务，功能评分由一位人类评估者完成，视觉质量评分由大语言模型生成并由该评估者验证。2. 前沿模型得分接近满分上限（42分），限制了检测改进的空间。3. xHigh努力水平仅在Opus 4.7上暴露，因此努力对比仅限于单一模型家族。4. 研究设计是观察性的，条件分配而非随机化，标准水平和token分析是对现有数据集的回顾性检验，而非预先注册的假设。5. 精简提示消融实验在主批次后数周进行，批次时间是一个残留的混淆因素。6. 会话成本是列表价格总和，token分解仅覆盖84次运行。未来工作方向包括：建议比较模型或审计输出时，首先确定服务路径添加的隐藏提示并报告。

gold_evidence.text: The design is observational, with conditions assigned rather than randomized, and the criterion level and token analyses are post hoc examinations of an existing dataset rather than preregistered hypotheses, so the Fisher exact p values reported should be read as descriptive summaries of association strength. The abridged prompt ablation runs were conducted several weeks after the main batches, under the same harness version, so batch timing is a residual confound for their functional, though not their visual, comparison. Session costs are list price totals that vary with the debugging path taken, and the token decomposition covers the 84 runs whose rubrics preserve the per model token breakdown in the end of session report.

It uses a single task; functional grading was performed by a single human evaluator, and visual quality ratings were produced by a large language model from screenshot review and verified by that evaluator. Frontier scores sit near the 42 point ceiling, which limits headroom for detecting improvement, although the null result for the tool is not merely a ceiling effect, because at High effort, where scores still scatter between 39 and 42, the tool also failed to help while effort did. The xHigh effort level is exposed only on Opus 4.7, so the effort contrast is within a single model family.
A reasonable recommendation is that anyone comparing models or auditing outputs first establish what hidden prompt, if any, the serving path adds, and report it.

gold_evidence.text: We study stabilizer state testing and learning with limited coherent quantum memory. Here an algorithm sequentially receives copies of an unknown n-qubit state, but may keep only k qubits of coherent quantum memory between measurements.
The sample complexity of testing stabilizer states in the k-qubit memory framework is Θ(n −k). Our upper bound goes via a novel connection to the hidden shift problem
The sample complexity of learning stabilizer states with k qubits of memory, in the non- adaptive framework, is Θ(n2/k).

even with k = 0.99n qubits of memory, there is no constant- copy stabilizer tester; furthermore for k = cn qubits of memory (for 0 < c < 1), stabilizer testing is as hard as learning, with both requiring Θ(n) copies.

title: Language Models as Measurement Apparatus for Culture
question: 这篇论文提出的核心方法是什么？
gold_answer: 该论文提出的核心方法是将语言模型作为文化测量的仪器，并引入“能动切割”概念，强调测量过程中物质配置（模型架构、训练数据）与研究者话语框架（标注类别、评估标准、解释承诺）的纠缠不可分。具体而言，通过将整个配置（模型、数据、标注、评估）视为一个参与产生其对象的整体装置，而非线性研究叙事中可分离的组件，来实现对文化的测量。

gold_evidence.text: I argue that this work constitutes a material-discursive practice (Barad, 2007; Brown and Duguid, 2000): the material configuration of the apparatus (model architecture, training data) and the discursive framework of the researcher (annotation categories, evaluation criteria, interpretive commitments) are entangled in the measurement and inseparable from it.

To make this concrete, I develop the concept of the agential cut (Barad, 2007) for cultural analytics: the contingent boundary that an apparatus enacts between what counts as phenomenon and what counts as instrument.

These observations suggest a framework that treats the entire configuration— model, data, annotation, evaluation—as a larger, coherent whole: indeed, an apparatus that participates in producing its object, not one treating data, task, and algorithm as separable components of a linear research narrative.

title: OrbitQuant: Data-Agnostic Quantization for Image and Video Diffusion Transformers
question: 这篇论文提出的核心方法是什么？
gold_answer: OrbitQuant是一种无需校准的权值-激活量化器，用于扩散变换器。它用单个分布码本替代每时间步的范围校准，该码本在共享、旋转、归一化的基上应用。旋转被离线吸收到权值中，并在每个线性层内部抵消，运行时仅对激活施加一次前向RPBH旋转。其随机排列使得旋转后的边缘分布在低位宽下保持良好。

gold_evidence.text: We present OrbitQuant, a calibration-free weight-activation quantizer for diffusion transformers that replaces per- timestep range calibration with a single distributional code- book applied in a shared, rotated, normalized basis.
The rotation is absorbed into the weights offline and cancels in- side each linear layer, leaving only a forward RPBH ro- tation on the activations at runtime.
Its random permuta- tion is what keeps the rotated marginal well-behaved at low bit-width.

title: OrbitQuant: Data-Agnostic Quantization for Image and Video Diffusion Transformers
question: 作者是如何证明所提方法有效的？
gold_answer: 作者通过实验评估证明了所提方法的有效性。在图像和视频扩散变换器上，OrbitQuant在无需校准数据的情况下，在GenEval和VBench上达到了最先进的训练后量化性能。在W2A4位宽下，当先前的训练后量化基线方法完全失效时，OrbitQuant是唯一仍能生成可用图像的方法。此外，在W3A3和W2A3等极低位宽下，OrbitQuant在多个模型上取得了最佳总体得分，且与全精度模型接近。在视频生成任务中，OrbitQuant在Wan 14B和HunyuanVideo等大型模型上，在多个维度上优于或持平于其他量化方法，甚至在某些维度上超越了需要微调的量化感知训练方法。

gold_evidence.text: We evaluate OrbitQuant on image and video DiTs, achieving state-of-the-art PTQ on GenEval and VBench without calibration data. At W2A4, where prior PTQ baselines collapse to noise, OrbitQuant is the only method that still produces usable images, shown in Figure 1.

At W3A3 OrbitQuant has the best Overall on all three models and stays close to FP16. ... W2A3 is the harder test. The rotation and smoothing baselines collapse to near zero on every model, since a 3-bit uniform grid cannot place its levels where the rotated activations are dense. OrbitQuant is the only method that stays functional, remaining usable on the FLUX models.

As a calibration-free PTQ method, OrbitQuant is generally a step below the strongest QAT baseline QVGen [20], whose fine-tuned objective targets video quality directly. Even so, it stays close across most VBench dimensions and surpasses every QAT method on several, leading on Subject Consistency, Scene, and Overall Consistency on Wan 2.1-1.3B.

title: OrbitQuant: Data-Agnostic Quantization for Image and Video Diffusion Transformers
question: 这篇论文的主要贡献是什么？
gold_answer: 本文的主要贡献包括：提出了一种免校准的权重-激活量化器OrbitQuant，用于扩散变换器，通过共享旋转归一化基上的分布码本替代逐时间步的校准；将相同的量化器扩展到权重行，采用共享旋转设计，使权重和激活在共同基上量化；提出了RPBH旋转，其均匀随机排列使激活在低位宽下无需校准即可良好量化；在图像和视频扩散变换器上评估了OrbitQuant，在无需校准数据的情况下，在GenEval和VBench上实现了最先进的PTQ性能，并在W2A4设置下是唯一能生成可用图像的方法。

gold_evidence.text: The main contributions of our work are as follows: • We cast low-bit DiT activation quantization as a distribtional codebook problem, replacing per-timestep range calibration with a single Lloyd–Max codebook fit to a fixed post-rotation marginal and shared across all denoising steps. • We extend the same quantizer to the weight rows with a shared-rotation design that quantizes weights and activations in one common basis. • We propose the RPBH rotation, an efficient rotation whose uniform random permutation keeps activations well-quantizable at low bit-width without calibration. • We evaluate OrbitQuant on image and video DiTs, achieving state-of-the-art PTQ on GenEval and VBench without calibration data. At W2A4, where prior PTQ baselines collapse to noise, OrbitQuant is the only method that still produces usable images, shown in Figure 1.

We present OrbitQuant, a calibration-free weight-activation quantizer for diffusion transformers that replaces per- timestep range calibration with a single distributional code- book applied in a shared, rotated, normalized basis.

The same recipe transfers from image to video with no per-modality tuning. Across FLUX.1, Z-Image-Turbo, Wan 2.1, and CogVideoX, it sets the state of the art for PTQ at several low-bit settings. It also pushes PTQ of image diffusion transformers to W2A4 with usable generation quality.

title: OrbitQuant: Data-Agnostic Quantization for Image and Video Diffusion Transformers
question: 这篇论文存在哪些局限性或未来工作方向？
gold_answer: 该论文的局限性包括：1）由于采用基于旋转的量化，每次前向传播时需要对激活值进行RPBH旋转，带来了额外的运行时旋转开销；2）当前实现中，由于Lloyd–Max质心是非均匀的，无法直接使用整数张量核心进行矩阵乘法，因此需要将量化码本反量化后再以BF16格式运行矩阵乘法，这是一个实现层面的限制。未来工作方向是构建融合内核，在GEMM前序阶段收集质心并以原生低位格式计算。

gold_evidence.text: OrbitQuant inherits the online rotation that comes with rotation-based quantization. Unlike weight-only or BF16 inference, it applies the RPBH to activations at every forward pass, so a runtime rotation cost accompanies the memory savings, though this cost is small.

Integer tensor cores compute on uniform grids, where the matmul runs directly on the quantized codes, while Lloyd–Max centroids are non-uniform, so no off-the-shelf kernel computes a codebook GEMM. Our current path therefore dequantizes codes and runs the matmul in BF16, as do all baselines under fake quantization.

Lookup-table GEMM kernels for non-uniform weight quantization [14, 34] suggest the path forward, and we will build a fused kernel that gathers centroids in the GEMM prologue and computes in a native low-bit format.

gold_answer: 该论文的核心方法是研究人类资本（尤其是观点采择、好奇心和智识谦逊）如何调节人工智能辅助预测的价值，并通过识别三种人机交互风格（自动者、验证者、赛博格）来揭示不同协作模式对预测准确性的影响。

gold_evidence.text: I report a pilot designed to estimate (i) whether human capital moderates the value of AI assistance in forecasting, and (ii) whether distinct interaction styles mediate that moderation.

The moderator that organizes the pattern is collaborative human capital, especially perspective-taking, curiosity, and intellectual humility, consistent with broader findings that heterogeneity in collaboration ability drives the returns to hybrid intelligence (11–14).

title: Ming.Human Capital & Hybrid Intelligence.arXiv
question: 这篇论文报告了哪些关键实验结果？
gold_answer: 论文报告了三个关键实验结果：第一，混合智能表现呈三模态分布，大多数参与者要么完全依赖模型（Automators），要么用模型验证自己的猜测（Validators），只有少数人进行真正的互补推理（Cyborgs），其准确度接近甚至超过市场基准。第二，Cyborgs在智力谦逊、好奇心和观点采择等人力资本特质上显著优于其他混合类型，而原始认知能力或模型基准无法区分这一模式。第三，Automators的表现优于纯人类但不如AI基线，Validators的表现甚至比纯人类更差，而Cyborgs的误差低于每个单独AI模型，并与市场基准无显著差异。

gold_evidence.text: hybrid performance is trimodal: most people either deferred to the model (matching it) or used it to rubber-stamp a prior guess (performing worse than the model alone), while a minority engaged in genuine complementary reasoning and reached accuracy matching or even exceeding (i.e., lower error than) the market itself.

Cyborgs exceeded other hybrid forecasters on intellectual humility (6.5 vs. 4.4, d = 4.1), curiosity (6.7 vs. 5.1, d = 4.0), and perspective-taking (6.5 vs. 4.6, d = 3.2), with smaller but reliable differences in fluid reasoning (d = 1.5) and g (d = 1.7) (all p < .01; Fig. 1B).

Automators reproduced roughly their tool’s behavior but not its accuracy (10.4, CI 9.7–11.0, n = 24)—better than humans alone (p < .001) yet worse than the AI-only baseline (5.5). Validators...were significantly worse than humans working alone (31.7, CI 20.6–42.7, n = 9; vs. human-only p = .017). Only Cyborgs improved on the machine: 3.8 (CI 3.5–4.1, n = 9), lower error than every individual AI model and statistically indistinguishable from—indeed numerically below the mean of—the strongest models, significantly better than Automators (p < .001).

gold_evidence.text: After pruning, the LLM prefill time is reduced from 320.51 ms to 77.60, 122.63, and 178.97 ms under 128, 256, and 512 retained tokens, respectively. Counting both pruning overhead and pruned prefill, the 128- and 256-token settings still provide clear acceleration, while the 512-token setting remains roughly comparable to the unpruned baseline.

EADP demonstrates exceptional prefill acceleration, peaking at a 5.9× speedup under 128-token budget. More importantly, the end-to-end latency metrics on Qwen2.5-VL reveal a critical vulnerability in existing methods: while baselines like HiPrune suffer from severe latency degradation, EADP remains highly stable and robust.

title: Embodied.cpp: A Portable Inference Runtime of Embodied AI Models on Heterogeneous Robots
question: 这篇论文的主要贡献是什么？
gold_answer: 本文的主要贡献包括三个方面：一是对代表性具身模型（包括视觉-语言-动作模型和世界-动作模型）进行了架构分析，揭示了共享的执行路径，主要差异集中在少量可插拔的头部和预测模块；二是设计了Embodied.cpp，一个可移植的C++推理运行时，将共享路径映射为五层架构，并提供了异构边缘设备的后端抽象；三是在两个广泛使用的VLA模型和一个代表性WAM基准上进行了评估，展示了在保持高精度的同时提升了部署效率。

gold_evidence.text: We make three contributions: • An architectural analysis of representative embodied models spanning vision-language-action (VLA) models and world-action models (WAMs), revealing a shared execution path whose main divergences are confined to a small set of pluggable heads and predictive modules. • The design of Embodied.cpp as a portable C++ inference runtime that maps this shared path into five layers: input adapters, sequence builders, backbone execution, head plugins, and deployment adapters, with backend abstraction for heterogeneous edge devices. • We evaluate Embodied.cpp on two widely used VLA models and one representative WAM benchmark, showing improved efficiency while maintaining high accuracy.

We evaluate Embodied.cpp on two VLA models, HY-VLA and pi0.5, and on a preliminary WAM benchmark using a LingBot-VA Transformer block. The VLA deployments achieve successful closed-loop execution with 100.0% and 91.0% task success rates, respectively. The WAM benchmark reduces block memory from 312.2 MiB to 88.1 MiB. These results show that Embodied.cpp improves deployment efficiency while preserving high accuracy across diverse embodied model architectures.
